task.instruction: Find a recipe for a vegetarian lasagna under 600 calories per serving that has a prep time of less than 1 hour.

final_answer:
I found a recipe that fits all your criteria: **Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna** on Allrecipes (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229764/easy-vegetarian-spinach-lasagna/).

**Why it qualifies:**
- **Vegetarian** — no meat; built on spinach, ricotta, mozzarella, Parmesan, egg, and pasta sauce
- **305 calories per serving** — comfortably under your 600-calorie limit
- **Prep time: 20 minutes** — well under 1 hour (cook time 1 hr, total 1 hr 25 min)
- Rated 4.6 stars from 117 ratings and 85 reviews; yields 6 servings

**Quick overview:** You preheat the oven to 400°F, blanch 10 oz fresh spinach, boil 9 lasagna noodles, then mix the spinach with ricotta, half the mozzarella, egg, nutmeg, and basil. Layer noodles, the ricotta-spinach mixture, and pasta sauce in a 1½-quart casserole, top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan, cover with foil, and bake 25 minutes covered plus about 25 minutes uncovered until bubbling and lightly browned. Let it rest 5 minutes before serving.

**Per serving:** 305 calories, 10g fat, 37g carbs (4g fiber), 18g protein, 443mg sodium.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna with vegetarian ingredients, Prep Time 20 mins, and Nutrition Facts 305 calories per serving.
